items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I come to know Lewis by, by being in the Tuxedo band.

ctx.x: Well, how would they work that two trumpet part? Would one of them use a mute and the other one not? Or would they play strict harmony or how would they work it?
You know the first trumpet that was Celestine. Mm-hmm. Celestine used to use the mute multiple times, you see? And Lewis was coming right behind him.
